description: This is a source code file for a REST API backend built with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy, defining various endpoints for user management, decks, notes, sharing, likes, comments, and search functionalities in a study hub platform.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint to check the health status of the API.

methods.name: create_user(user: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new user in the system with hashed password.

methods.name: list_users(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of all users.

methods.name: get_user(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves user details by user ID.

methods.name: user_profile(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Fetches profile information for a user.

methods.name: create_deck(deck: schemas.DeckCreate, owner_id: int = Query(...), db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new deck owned by a user.

methods.name: list_decks( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, public_only: bool = False, owner_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Lists decks with optional filters for owner and public status.

methods.name: get_deck(deck_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Fetches details of a deck by its ID.

methods.name: update_deck(deck_id: int, deck: schemas.DeckCreate, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Updates the properties of an existing deck.

methods.name: delete_deck(deck_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a deck by ID.

methods.name: create_note(deck_id: int, note: schemas.NoteCreate, author_id: int = Query(...), db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new note within a specified deck.

methods.name: list_notes(deck_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Lists all notes for a given deck.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note: schemas.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Updates an existing note.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a note.

methods.name: share_deck(deck_id: int, share: schemas.DeckShareCreate, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Shares a deck with a user, with specific permissions.

methods.name: list_shares(deck_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Lists all share entries for a deck.

methods.name: delete_share(share_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Removes a share entry.

methods.name: like_deck(deck_id: int, user_id: int = Query(...), db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Likes a deck; prevents multiple likes from the same user.

methods.name: get_deck_likes(deck_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves all likes for a deck.

methods.name: remove_like(like_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Removes a like.

methods.name: add_comment(comment: schemas.CommentCreate, user_id: int = Query(...), db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Adds a comment to a deck or note.

methods.name: list_comments(deck_id: Optional[int] = None, note_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Lists comments for a deck or note.

methods.name: delete_comment(comment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a comment.

methods.name: search( q: str = Query(..., description="Search query"), limit: int = 10, db: Session = Depends(session.get_db) )
methods.description: Performs a search over decks and notes based on a query string.
